node.statement: Polar square comparison for the fixed pair: write u=u_delta(X), h=h_delta(X), and a=h-J for the typed inverse pair supplied in 1.1. Then X=u bold-dot h, u lies in calU, h is Hermitian, and ||a||<delta. Thus ||u||^2<=1/(1-epsilon_r)<=16/15 by the C*-lower bound applied to u^dagger bold-dot u=J, while ||h||<=1+delta<=17/16. The involution axiom gives X^dagger=h bold-dot u^dagger. Two associator comparisons, from (h bold-dot u^dagger) bold-dot (u bold-dot h) to ((h bold-dot u^dagger) bold-dot u) bold-dot h and then to (h bold-dot (u^dagger bold-dot u)) bold-dot h=h bold-dot h, together with the product-norm axiom give ||X^dagger bold-dot X-h bold-dot h||<=2*epsilon_r*(1+epsilon_r)||h||^2||u||^2<=(9826/3840)*epsilon_r<=3*epsilon_r.
